Use the scenario package already owned by the project. A package is ordinary files and native tools;

Keep CLIENT at its native full viewport size and never resize it. Raise and focus it, record its final title and geometry, and capture only its unobstructed screen region. If minimizing the host fails, the one bounded setup repair may move that exact host window wholly off the visible screen before recapture. Never treat pixels of a covering window as the selected window’s pixels.

Before gameplay, create a fresh initial CLIENT PNG and read that exact PNG with OMP’s ordinary read tool so its pixels enter this same active Sol turn. Record what the pixels directly show. File existence, metadata, filename, or command success is not image observation.

Before every input or capture, raise and focus the exact chosen CLIENT numeric ID. Read the exact resulting PNG with OMP ordinary read in this same Sol session and continue only when its pixels visibly identify CLIENT. Report invalid only if exact routing, native image ingestion, native input, or recapture remains unavailable after that repair; do not substitute source, logs, scripts, tests, or another evidence path.

Then stop and restart both native processes from a clean state.

Launch 2: attempt the complete intended journey—collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, recover, load the truck, drive to the destination, leave the seat, and unload. Stop on completion or a reproducible blocker.

A pass requires direct visual evidence that the shortcut does not complete and that the complete journey does complete. Infer neither result from logs, source, scripts, tests, or the other run. Attempt the goal naturally and separate direct visual observation from inference and uncertainty.

Preserve a compact action trace; the numeric ID/title map for each launch; each final CLIENT title and geometry; exact fresh initial and decision-relevant PNGs; direct observations separated from inference and uncertainty; and an honest verdict naming every skipped or unverified item. Do not prescribe a backlog, contact production, deploy, publish, purchase, or declare founder acceptance.
